Drafted from occupysaas.com. This is the source of truth for public wording until the collective agrees otherwise.

<span id="core-line"></span>
== Core line ==

'''They laid us off. We’re rebuilding their SaaS.'''

<span id="message-pillars"></span>
== Message pillars ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Pillar
! Say
|-
| Fairness
| Per-seat pricing is a tax on growth; infrastructure should not charge rent by the head
|-
| Freedom
| Lock-in is not a feature; compatible open alternatives set customers free
|-
| Craft
| A million engineers were let go; we still know how to ship, and we ship in the open
|-
| Method
| Clean room, AI rebuild, drop-in, proven against the vendors’ own public SDKs
|-
| Ownership
| Your code, your data, your servers; no seats, no renewals, nobody who can switch it off but you
|}

<span id="proof-points-we-can-cite"></span>
== Proof points we can cite ==

* [[ZeroAuthy]] is OpenID Certified for the Basic OP, Config OP and Form Post OP profiles, and is tested with several Auth0 SDKs and CLIs.
* Every project is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable.
* Each project publishes a clean-room policy and source provenance so anyone can check the work.

<span id="claims-we-do-not-make"></span>
== Claims we do not make ==

* That either project is production-ready (both are early previews).
* That SalesCompel is certified, or fully compatible with Salesforce.
* Any affiliation with, or endorsement by, Auth0, Okta or Salesforce.
* Legal advice. Clean-room reimplementation is a long-established way to build compatible software, but anyone adopting a project for a business should talk to their own counsel.

<span id="tone"></span>
== Tone ==

Direct, a little defiant, never abusive toward individuals or vendors’ staff. The protest is aimed at pricing and lock-in models, not at people.

<span id="fundraising-wording"></span>
== Fundraising wording ==

Donations support the collective doing the work. We run two fundraisers because some people will not use one platform or the other: GoFundMe and GiveSendGo, plus Buy Me a Coffee for small tips.
